name: taskbullet-agent
description: Escalate unfinished agent work to a TaskBullet human virtual assistant, place US and Canada phone calls, and request a human-sent email, through TaskBullet's hosted MCP server. The user supplies their own TaskBullet API key. Nothing runs locally.

TASKBULLET_API_KEY.title: TaskBullet API key
TASKBULLET_API_KEY.description: The user's own tb_live_ key from https://taskbullet.com/dashboard/settings/api-keys. Grok sends it as x-api-key to https://taskbullet.com/api/agent-mcp. Set it in plugin configuration. Do not paste it into chat. The server does not advertise OAuth.
